recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多顆異常嗜酸性球，胞質內混有粗大深紫色（嗜鹼性）顆粒與橘紅色顆粒，並伴隨核摺疊的單核球系細胞，是AML伴inv(16)／CBFB::MYH11的典型表現。
features: Abnormal eosinophils with large, dark purple-violet basophilic-staining granules admixed with orange eosinophilic granules
Immature monocytic cells with folded or indented nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm
Blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli
Cellular aspirate with mixed myelomonocytic population
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular mixed population of myeloblasts, immature monocytic cells with folded nuclei, and increased eosinophils. Many eosinophils are abnormal, containing large dark purple-violet granules intermixed with typical orange granules. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, characteristic of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB::MYH11, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics, FISH, or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, and cytogenetic or molecular testing for CBFB::MYH11 is required; abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules strongly favor inv(16).
CMML has fewer than 20% blasts and promonocytes and lacks the dysplastic basophilic-granule eosinophils of inv(16).

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: These show mature-appearing eosinophilia with PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, or JAK2 rearrangements rather than CBFB::MYH11.
